findings.claim: Section 201 進口晶矽太陽能電池／模組安全防護關稅於 2026-02-06 到期，結束長達八年的對低價進口品限制
findings.source: Beveridge & Diamond (bdlaw.com) - Solar's Momentum At Mid-2026 Will Help It Overcome Snags
findings.excerpt: Most notably, the Section 201 safeguard tariffs on imported crystalline silicon photovoltaic cells and modules expired on Feb. 6, ending an eight-year effort to address low-cost imports that were found to injure U.S. manufacturers.

findings.claim: 美國川普政府對多晶矽（polysilicon）進口啟動 Section 232 國安調查行動，First Solar 表示此舉有助削弱中國在該供應鏈的掌控，並藉此撤回 USITC 337 條款申訴、轉向聯邦地方法院訴訟追討專利權
findings.source: Yahoo Finance - First Solar Recalibrates TOPCon IP Enforcement Strategy Following Section 232 Action
findings.excerpt: The decision follows the Trump Administration's recent national security action on imports of polysilicon and its derivatives under Section 232 of the Trade Expansion Act, a move aimed at loosening China's grip on a critical supply chain. ... The Trump Administration's Section 232 action helps level the playing field at the border, and we are more determined than ever to enforce our IP rights and defend the rule of law here at home.

regulatory_antitrust.note: 查無反壟斷／獨占調查或拆分風險（DOJ、FTC、EU 競爭主管機關對 FSLR 均無相關案件）；找到的是產業特定貿易/監管新規（Section 201 關稅到期為負向、Section 232 多晶矽國安行動為正向），與反壟斷無關但屬本軸涵蓋範圍。另查到 USITC 337 專利訴訟（FSLR 對 Axitec/Canadian Solar/JinkoSolar 等）與證券詐欺集體訴訟，均非反壟斷性質，未列入 findings。
